'''Ziyang Gao''' (in Chinese: ''高紫阳'') is a Chinese mathematician. He is a professor at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]]. 
His research concerns [[arithmetic geometry]], [[Diophantine geometry]], [[Shimura varieties]] and [[transcendental number theory]].

In 2022, along with [[Vesselin Dimitrov]], Gao won the [[Journal of Number Theory|David Goss Prize]] for his work on Shimura varieties and Diophantine geometry[[Number theory|.]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Vesselin Dimitrov and Ziyang Gao win the 2022 David Goss Prize|url=https://www.math.columbia.edu/~goldfeld/GossPrize2022.pdf}}</ref> His work on the uniform Mordell conjecture, joint with [[Vesselin Dimitrov]] and [[Philipp Habegger]] is considered a major breakthrough in diophantine geometry and is the resolution of a 40-year old conjecture.<ref name="SA">{{Cite web |last=Crowell |first=Rachel |title=A Century-Old Question Is Still Revealing Answers in Fundamental Math |url=https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/a-century-old-question-is-still-revealing-answers-in-fundamental-math/ |access-date=2026-05-29 |website=Scientific American |language=en}}</ref>

==Career==
Gao received his Bachelor of Science in mathemtics from [[Peking University]] in 2010 and his PhD from [[Université Paris-Sud]] and [[Leiden University]] in 2015, under the supervision of [[Emmanuel Ullmo]] and [[Bas Edixhoven]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Mathematical Genealogy Project: Ziyang Gao|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=188222}}</ref>.  He was a member at the [[Institute of Advanced Study]] in 2015 <ref>{{cite web|title= Institute of Advanced Study: Ziyang Gao|date=9 December 2019 |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/ziyang-gao}}</ref> and an Instructor at [[Princeton University]] from 2016 to 2018. From 2015 to 2021, he also worked as a researcher at [[French National Centre for Scientific_Research|CNRS]]. In 2021, he took up an appointment as a [[Academic ranks in Germany|W3 professor]] in [[Leibniz University Hannover]]. As of 2024, he is a professor at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]].

==Research==
Gao extended results of Edixhoven, Bruno Klingler, Ullmo and Andrei Yafaev, and of [[Jonathan Pila]], [[Jacob Tsimerman]] and [[Umberto Zannier]] from Shimura varieties to mixed Shimura varieties, thereby extending Tsimerman's work on the [[Andre-Oort conjecture]] to mixed Shimura varieties.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Towards the Andre-Oort conjecture for mixed Shimura varieties: the Ax-Lindemann theorem and lower bounds for Galois orbits of special points |year=2017|journal=J. Reine Angew. Math.|issue=732|page=85-146}}</ref>

In joint work with Habegger, Gao resolved the geometric [[Bogomolov conjecture]] for [[Algebraic function field|function fields]] of curves in characteristic zero. <ref>{{cite journal|last1 = Gao|first1 = Ziyang | last2= Habegger | first2 = Philipp| journal=Annals of Mathematics|title=Heights in families of abelian varieties and the geometric Bogomolov conjecture|issue=2|year=2019|volume = 189 |page=527-604 |doi = 10.4007/annals.2019.189.2.3 }}</ref>  Together with Dimitrov and Habegger, Gao proved a uniform version of the [[Mordell conjecture]] (also known as [[Faltings]]' theorem), thereby proving [[Uniform boundedness conjecture for rational points#Mazur's Conjecture B|Mazur's Conjecture B]].<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Dimitrov|first1=Vesselin|last2=Gao|first2=Ziyang|last3=Habegger|first3=Phillip|journal=Annals of Mathematics |title=Uniformity in Mordell-Lang for curves|issue=1|year=2021|volume=194 |page=237-298 |doi=10.4007/annals.2021.194.1.4 |arxiv=2001.10276 }}</ref> The uniform Mordell conjecture is considered a major breakthrough in diophantine geometry and is the resolution of a 40-year old conjecture. <ref name="SA" /> With Tangli Ge and Lars Kühne, Gao extended his result on uniform Mordell from curves in Jacobians to subvarieties of abelian varieties, hence proving a uniform version of the Mordell-Lang conjecture. <ref>{{cite journal|last1=Gao|first1=Ziyang|last2=Ge|first2=Tangli|last3=Kühne |first3=Lars|title = The Uniform Mordell-Lang Conjecture
|year=2026|journal=Publ. Math. de l'IHES|volume=143|pages=189-235|doi=10.5802/pmihes.26}}</ref> Together with Habegger, Gao also proved the relative [[Bogomolov conjecture#Manin-Mumford conjecture|Manin-Mumford conjecture]].<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Gao|first1=Ziyang|last2=Habegger|first2=Philipp|title= The relative Manin-Mumford conjecture|year= 2026|journal=Inventiones Mathematicae|doi=10.1007/s00222-026-01443-3|arxiv=2303.05045}}</ref>

==Awards==

* In 2015, the Stieljtes prize for his PhD dissertation.<ref>{{cite web|title=Stieltjes Prize: best Mathematical thesis prize for PhD student Ziyang Gao|date=19 November 2015 |url=https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/news/2015/11/stieltjes-prize-best-mathematical-thesis-prize-for-phd-student-ziyang-gao}}</ref>
* In 2022, along with [[Vesselin Dimitrov]], the [[Journal of Number Theory|David Goss Prize]] for his work on Shimura varieties and Diophantine geometry, which is awarded every two years to outstanding mathematicians below the age of 35 for their contributions to [[Number theory|number theory.]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Vesselin Dimitrov and Ziyang Gao win the 2022 David Goss Prize|url=https://www.math.columbia.edu/~goldfeld/GossPrize2022.pdf}}</ref>
* In 2024 the Frontiers in Science award for his joint paper with Dimitrov and [[Philipp Habegger]] on the uniform Mordell conjecture.<ref>{{cite web|title= Frontiers in Science Awards|url=https://2024.icbs.cn/site/pages/index/index?pageId=2cd3eaea-5f56-4cb1-9276-5a3a9ca39223}}</ref> 
* In 2025 the Compositio prize for his paper titled "Generic rank of Betti map and unlikely intersections".<ref>{{cite web|title=Professor Ziyang Gao awarded the Compositio Prize
|date=10 September 2025 |url=https://ww3.math.ucla.edu/professor-ziyang-gao-awarded-the-compositio-prize/}}</ref>
